the full article and underlying quantitative results were not supplied."]},{"source_id":"SRC-89ac8f0666c3d66f","start_unit":4,"end_unit":4,"fact_summary":"On 9 November 2023, Sisi approved Law 176/2023 granting a 30-year concession to a company being formed by a consortium including Abu Dhabi Ports to build, develop, operate, exploit, maintain, and return a multipurpose terminal at Safaga seaport.","question_ids":["5B.1","5B.4","5B.6","8B.2","8B.6"],"polarity":"context","period_fit":"Directly dated to 2023.","ruler_attribution":"The source directly reports Sisi's formal approval of the law.","limitations":["The supplied report does not provide procurement details, financing, implementation progress, distributional effects, or independent evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-3c99343dd2d72d42","start_unit":2,"end_unit":2,"fact_summary":"A civil-society 2023 annual report states that Egypt's Supreme Council for Media Regulation has broad powers over licensing, blocking, and content oversight, and describes the country's legal, security, and professional media environment as restrictive.","question_ids":["4B.3","4B.4","4B.6","4B.9"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"The report analyzes council activity during 2023 and was published on 15 January 2024.","ruler_attribution":"The report concerns a state regulatory institution under the government's authority; the supplied extract does not establish 2023 completion or outcomes.","ruler_attribution":"The project was promoted by Egypt's government during Sisi's rule; the extract does not document a specific personal decision by Sisi.","limitations":["The extract is an abstract and does not provide executed budgets, completion milestones, service outcomes, displacement effects, or independent evaluation."]},{"source_id":"SRC-1b65a13254087a88","start_unit":3,"end_unit":3,"fact_summary":"Amnesty International reports that Egyptian security forces unlawfully killed more than 900 people during the 2013 dispersal of sit-ins at Rabaa al-Adawiya and Nahda squares, and states that over the following decade authorities intensified their assault on peaceful dissent while shielding officials from accountability.","question_ids":["3B.1","3B.2","3B.4","3B.8","4B.3","4B.4","7B.6","7B.7"],"polarity":"adverse","period_fit":"Published 14 August 2023;
